tasks.title: Create Environment Configuration Template
tasks.description: Create a .env.example file documenting all required environment variables with descriptions and example values. This provides clear setup guidance for users.
acceptance_criteria: Includes instructions on how to obtain these values
tasks.technical_notes: Should include comments explaining where to find Notion API keys and database IDs

tasks.title: Enhance README with Comprehensive Documentation
tasks.description: Expand README.md to include project overview, setup instructions, usage examples, API documentation, and troubleshooting guidance.
acceptance_criteria: README includes project description and purpose
Usage examples for all exported functions
API reference for createTask and updateTask

tasks.title: Fix Assigned To Functionality
tasks.description: Implement the assignedTo parameter in createTask function. Currently accepts the parameter but sets people array to empty. Need to properly map assignedTo to Notion people property.
acceptance_criteria: People property correctly populated in Notion
Function handles both email and user ID formats
Appropriate error handling for invalid assignees
tasks.technical_notes: Notion people property requires user IDs or emails. May need to query workspace users first or document expected format.

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Function
tasks.description: Create a getTask function to retrieve a specific task by page ID from the Notion database. Returns task details including all properties.
acceptance_criteria: Returns task object with all properties
Returns null or throws descriptive error for invalid IDs

tasks.title: Implement Task Query/List Function
tasks.description: Create a listTasks function to query the Notion database with optional filters (status, assignee, date range). Returns array of tasks matching criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Proper error handling for invalid filters
tasks.technical_notes: Use notion.databases.query() API method with filter objects

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion Function
tasks.description: Create a deleteTask function to archive/delete a task from the Notion database by page ID. Notion archives pages rather than permanently deleting them.
tasks.technical_notes: Use notion.pages.update() with archived: true property

tasks.title: Enhance Error Handling and Validation
tasks.description: Improve error handling across all functions. Add input validation, descriptive error messages, and proper error propagation. Validate environment variables on startup.
acceptance_criteria: Environment variables validated at module load
Descriptive error messages for common failures
Network errors handled with retry logic or clear messaging
tasks.technical_notes: Consider creating custom error classes for different failure types

tasks.title: Add Logging Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement structured logging with configurable log levels (debug, info, warn, error). Replace console.log/error with proper logging framework.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable log levels via environment variable
All console.log/error replaced with logger calls
Log levels appropriately assigned to messages
tasks.technical_notes: Consider winston or pino for logging. Add LOG_LEVEL environment variable.

tasks.title: Create Unit Tests for Core Functions
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive unit tests for all exported functions using a testing framework. Mock Notion API calls to avoid external dependencies during testing.
acceptance_criteria: npm test command executes tests successfully
tasks.technical_notes: Use Jest with ES modules support. Mock @notionhq/client for testing.

tasks.title: Refactor Main Function for Better Examples
tasks.description: Update the main() example function to demonstrate all available functionality including new functions. Make it more comprehensive and educational.
acceptance_criteria: Code is well-commented for educational purposes
tasks.technical_notes: Consider making main() conditional on a RUN_EXAMPLE environment variable

tasks.title: Add CLI Interface
tasks.description: Create a command-line interface for interacting with the task tracker without writing code. Support commands for create, update, list, get, and delete operations.
acceptance_criteria: Package.json includes bin entry for CLI
CLI properly handles errors and displays user-friendly messages
tasks.technical_notes: Consider using commander or yargs for CLI framework

tasks.title: Create Integration Tests
tasks.description: Implement integration tests that verify functionality against a real Notion test database. These tests should be optional and run only when test credentials are provided.
acceptance_criteria: Tests run against real Notion API with test database
Tests only run when NOTION_TEST_DATABASE_ID is set
Tests cover complete workflows (create, update, retrieve, delete)
Separate npm script for integration tests
tasks.technical_notes: Use separate test database ID. Include setup/teardown to avoid polluting production data.
